Historical verb, using the licensed venir morphology model with the avenir stem. Académie fifth edition restricts it to third persons and explicitly attests avint, avienne, aviendra/aviendront, avient, avenant, avenu/avenue, est avenu and sont avenues. Original historical spellings are retained beside model forms. This is not the modern noun avenir.
